stories.title: Gilts v kilts: What is happening with Scottish government bonds?
stories.summary: MSPs have heard both the pros and cons of the government's plan to launch its first ever bond to the market?

stories.title: Plan to store wind farm parts at Skye's Broadford Aerodrome
stories.summary: The airfield used to have flights to Glasgow and was a location for the 1980s film Flash Gordon.

stories.title: 'No rescue required' as boat found partially sunk off Orkney
stories.summary: The wreck, which has not been formally identified, was reported at about 10:30 and the coastguard sent an aircraft to inspect the site.

stories.title: Falkirk's Cladhan Hotel closes permanently to asylum seekers
stories.summary: The hotel was the site of several heated demonstrations last summer which led to multiple arrests.

stories.summary: CMAL chief executive says he is opposed to directly awarding new ship orders to the nationalised firm, despite it being Scottish government policy.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto staff 'caught red-handed' in confidentiality breach, tribunal hears
stories.summary: Rockstar Games said it took action after staff discussed confidential information on a Discord server which had hundreds of members.

stories.title: Three men arrested over Edinburgh pub shooting
stories.summary: One injured person was treated at the scene after shots were fired at a bar in Gilmerton last month.

stories.title: Driver accused of trying to murder man on electric motorbike
stories.summary: Sinem Aktas, 29, denies attempted murder after an incident in Aberdeen in June last year.

stories.title: Man who filmed 'horrific' animal fight videos jailed
stories.summary: Ryan Cringean has been jailed for 18 months and banned from keeping a dog for 10 years at Dumfries Sheriff Court.

stories.title: What is Scotland’s greatest ever cultural export?
stories.summary: Sanjeev Kohli, Jenny Colgan, Susie McCabe and Nicola Benedetti give their take.

stories.title: Police treating 'targeted' shooting of woman as attempted murder
stories.summary: The 27-year-old, who was shot in Glasgow on Monday night, is in hospital in a critical but stable condition.

stories.title: Major oil and gas firm EnQuest pulls out of the North Sea
stories.summary: EnQuest said its decision followed uncertainty over investment and tax rises in recent years, and will focus its business on south-east Asia.
